questions.prompt: What is the primary function of a reverse proxy?

choices.text: To intercept requests from clients and forward them to the appropriate server
To provide secure access to internal resources
To load balance traffic across multiple servers

questions.explanation:
The core function is to receive client requests and forward them to backend servers. Security controls and load balancing are common additional capabilities, so "All of the above" is also plausible if the question is asking about capabilities. Because "primary function" makes the options ambiguous, this item is shown for review but excluded from scoring.

Answer reference: https://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.4/en/howto/reverse_proxy.html
